data.title: Page of Lambda
data.synopsis:
Nijisanji members Lize Helesta, Ange Katrina, and Inui Toko.
Commonly known as "Sanbaka," what if their original story was made into an anime?
We imagined and created a world where these girls could exist together and produced the opening animation and setting materials.
This is a new story of Sanbaka that transcends the boundaries between reality and fiction.
Let's go on a journey together to imagine and create new sides to these girls!

(Source: Official Webpage, translated)

data.title: Help me, ERINNNNNN!! (Game Size Ver.)
data.title_japanese: Help me, ERINNNNNN!![ゲームサイズ ver.]
data.synopsis: Official collaboration between Project SEKAI and COOL&CREATE, released to promote the former's "Touhou Collaboration" event.
data.background: Help me, ERINNNNNN!! was a preexisting song performed by COOL&CREATE, originally composed by ZUN and arranged by beatMARIO. The song was re-arranged by beatMARIO and Maron, and released digitally on May 3, 2024. The VIRTUAL SINGER version was added to Project SEKAI as part of its "Touhou Collaboration", alongside a re-arranged version of Saishuu Kichiku Imouto Flandre S (also by COOL&CREATE) and Bad Apple by Alstroemeria Records. (Source: Project SEKAI wiki, edited)

data.title: Shi Dao Zhe
data.title_english: Arknights' Original Animation: The Daggers' Inheritors
data.synopsis:
Theresa was assassinated and the Tower of Babel fell. After the nameless soldiers involved in the core assassination mission were eliminated, W's anger was not extinguished yet. Next on the revenge list is a team of Sarkaz mercenaries who provided assistance outside the assassination operation. They were escorting "something" and fleeing to the border...

This is a memory that W has never mentioned.

It is the epitome of the Sakazi's struggle to survive the long war - the victim will pick up the dagger of the victimizer, and the cycle of destiny will continue.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

titles.title: ロクローの大ぼうけん

data.title: Rokurou no Daibouken
data.title_japanese: ロクローの大ぼうけん
data.synopsis:
One day, twelve amulets that protect the world are shattered. By whom? While the curse of shattered pieces is spreading to people around the world, for some reason there is only one person who is not under the curse. That is Rokuro. Rokuro sets on a journey with his big brother Goro and younger sister Nanako to save their family and eventually the world. With a magic brush that he got from a hermit, Rokuro's great adventure starts! 

(Source: Official Site)

是王者啊？第3季 有求必应星之队
data.synopsis:
Let's traverse the desert in the clouds together, heading to the starting point of heroes' dreams: Jixia Academy! After the Return to the Void Dream Performance, Yao, the passionate and somewhat eccentric captain of the Star Team, didn't want the team to disband. He wanted to continue engaging in team activities at school to strengthen team cohesion, and he came up with a brilliant idea… to accept various requests during their spare time. 

In the process of solving one bizarre incident after another, the members of the Star Team deepened their bonds. The Star Team officially became the "Always-Awaited Star Team"—"The Star Team is on the move, and it's done in no time!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)
